body:
Maps existing process activity gating, Study-only policy and generation-fenced expiring control snapshot on the Redis census dependency. Records database authority, optional-work fail-closed behavior and essential task exceptions without changing service behavior. The census remains partial.

Validation: component checker, four scoped ownership/discovery tests and seven Study priority control tests passed using existing task-owned dependencies; no build or service was started. Two diagnostics, 24 PGN scope, nineteen earlier and ten missing-adapter fixture gaps remain unresolved. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Add Study control ownership mapping and validation to the component census without changing service behavior.

Enhancements:
- Map Study control ownership across activity gating, Study-only policy, and expiring control snapshots in the component census.
- Extend census validation to discover Study control files and prevent their ownership scope from being removed silently.

Documentation:
- Update the component-build documentation to reflect the expanded Study control census and remaining coverage gaps.

Tests:
- Add scoped ownership and discovery coverage for the Study control census.
title: Map Study control ownership
